This is a sharp, all-index structural sign-faithfulness threshold on the smallest mass-conserving strongly convex mode; arbitrary small exact positive initial data can undergo infinitely many spurious phase reversals although the semidiscrete flow keeps its sign and the numerical fixed point attracts. It clarifies meaningful tension between modified-energy stability and physical sign behavior, beyond an isolated test or a generic textbook root exercise.
